test_title: PYST 26: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Morning)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, NORMAL is written as DIPKRO and OBTAIN is written as DYLKRQ. How will PROFIT be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1196a07d03c9f02e7bec22cfc36a195fd3a58e076da25a1e2a394b79aea80ec7.png] 

The logic follows here is:

In NORMAL:

Arranged in alphabetical order: ALMNOR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a270b64b018543e5373ec0fa48ef9295baa6ac815a4c74eef94eb210233cac3.png] 

In OBTAIN:

Arranged in alphabetical order: ABINOT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f9264b0b5b93694d5ac56ce35589101d23c94ed6c669e9e235c4b305376d24.png] 

Similarly;

In PROFIT:

Arranged in alphabetical order: FIOPRT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb8daef425f982bb02469966102846e6d0184bb7a32bf9103b4fff2cd1fc60ae.png] 

Hence, **"IFRMUQ"** is the correct answer.
